issues: 没有导出时长常量，工作台按 md 抓成 10f，改版前视频是两行灰字，一个词都没开始填
填色前沿是 clip-path 硬切口，正在读的词和读完的词同一个深色，看不出哪个词是此刻
读指是一根 8px 直角黑条，读完一帧消失，没有收尾动作
标语靠左 240px 内边距排，构图偏左；Helvetica 字体，灰平底
静音预览没有任何旁白参照，变色读起来没头没脑
changes: 导出 KARAOKE_FILL_SYNC_DURATION = 150（末词 f130 填完，f140 前退色 / 收线完毕，静止到 150）
揭开改用 mask 线性渐变带 ±4% 柔边前沿，词内仍按语速线性推进；正在读的词填强调色 #5b63d3，读完 10f 退成主墨色
读指改成 8px 强调色圆角条带柔影，右缘跟随前沿，读完 6f 从左往右收掉
标语两行居中，SF Pro 800 / 150px 负字距，未读字用 13% 墨色；柔光背景加颗粒
底部加 48 根竖条的旁白波形：词内起伏、换气处回落，已播部分着强调色，作静音预览的参照
issuesEn: No exported duration constant: the workbench took 10f from the md, so the before video shows two lines of gray text without a single word filled
The fill edge was a hard clip-path cut, and words being read and words already read used the same dark color, so it was unclear which word was current
The reading pointer was an 8px square-cornered black bar that vanished in a single frame when a word finished
The tagline was laid out flush left with 240px of padding, pulling the composition left; Helvetica on a flat gray ground
A silent preview had no narration cue at all, so the color changes looked unmotivated
changesEn: Exported KARAOKE_FILL_SYNC_DURATION = 150 (the last word finishes filling at f130, color settle and pointer retract finish before f140, then hold to 150)

The reveal now uses a linear-gradient mask with a ±4% soft leading edge, still advancing linearly at speaking pace; the current word fills in the accent #5b63d3 and settles to the main ink over 10f once read
The pointer is now an 8px rounded accent bar with a soft shadow; its right edge tracks the fill, and once the word is read it retracts left to right over 6f
Both lines are centered in SF Pro 800 at 150px with negative tracking, unread words in 13% ink; soft-lit backdrop with grain
Added a 48-bar narration waveform at the bottom that rises during words, drops at the breath pauses and colors the played portion in the accent, as a cue for silent previews
